Package neqsim.process.operations.replay

Class ReplayBinding

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.replay.ReplayBinding
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReplayBinding extends Object implements Serializable
Binding between a data-series tag and a ProcessAutomation address used by ProcessReplay.

An input binding reads a column of the time series, converts it with value * scale + offset, applies an optional transform and writes the result to the automation address in getUnit(). An output binding reads the automation address in getUnit() as the model prediction and converts the measured column with the same scale, offset and transform so that both are compared in the model unit.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL

    • withValidRange

      public ReplayBinding withValidRange(double min, double max)
      Sets the valid range of the converted value. Values outside the range mark the step as having invalid input (for an input binding) or as an invalid measurement (for an output binding).
      Parameters:
      min - minimum valid converted value
      max - maximum valid converted value
      Returns:
      this binding
